name: ColorInput
description: A color chip beside a text field for choosing a color as a hex string. Clicking the chip opens a picker (saturation square, hue and optional alpha, hex field) in a popover; the text field takes typed or pasted hex codes.
usage: Use for selecting or inputting color values in hex format.
onChange(hex) is called with the new color, value first: upper-case, with # added, whether typed or picked
Controlled with value, or uncontrolled with defaultValue
Pass alpha and onAlphaChange to show the alpha slider
The hex check (and your validate) shows after the first blur; an error the app passes shows at once unless touched is false
The ref goes to the text field; unnamed props (name, aria-*, data-*, onFocus…) go to it too
design: The component pairs a color chip (button) and a text input, visually merged like TextInput with a prepended chip.
The picker opens in a portalled popover beside the chip, on whichever side has room.
Sizes from the input scale ('2xs' to 'lg', utils/inputSizing.ts), default 'md'; compact is the deprecated alias for 'xs'
The text field shows focus with a 1px var(--color-primary) ring (var(--color-error) in error); the chip a keyboard ring, 2px var(--color-border-focus) offset 2px on var(--color-surface-canvas)
Uses design system tokens for borders, focus rings, text colors, and error states.
accessibility: The text field is named by its label (htmlFor/id), or by aria-label / aria-labelledby passed through
The chip is a button named 'Choose <label> color', with aria-expanded and aria-haspopup="dialog"; the picker is a role="dialog" and Escape closes it, returning focus to the chip
A shown error sets aria-invalid on the text field and aria-describedby to the message (merged with any aria-describedby passed in)
disabled sets the native disabled on the field and the chip

props.name: id
props.description: The text field's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the color, a hex string such as #RRGGBB. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled: the color at first

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new color (upper-case hex, # added), typed or picked

props.name: alpha
props.description: Current alpha (0-100); used when the alpha slider shows

props.name: onAlphaChange
props.description: Called when the alpha changes; passing it shows the alpha slider

props.name: hideAlpha
props.description: Hide the alpha slider; defaults to true unless onAlphaChange is given

props.name: error
props.description: The app's error message: shows at once unless touched is false; replaces the helper text

props.name: validate
props.description: Your own check, after the hex check; its message shows after the first blur, or when touched is true

props.name: helperText
props.description: Text displayed below the input when not in an error state.

props.name: touched
props.description: Leave out to show an error the app passes at once; pass the field's touched state to hold it until the field is left. false hides errors

props.name: size
props.description: Size from the input scale

props.name: compact
props.description: Deprecated: use size="xs". size wins when both are given

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required (adds asterisk to label).

props.name: disabled
props.description: The field and the chip natively disabled; nothing fires

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the text field loses focus

props.name: className
props.description: CSS classes for the outer container, merged with cn() so yours win

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: CSS classes for the text <input>

props.name: chipClassName
props.description: CSS classes for the color chip <button>

props.name: ref
props.description: The text field

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (name, aria-*, data-*, onFocus…) goes to the text field
